title: SEC3: Factor repeated state capture pattern in test harness
description: In kithd/tests/group_and_receipt.rs, multiple tests capture message state before and after operations (lines 1349-1365, 1475-1478, 1803-1806, etc). The pattern is: lock store, call get_state(), unlock, perform operation, lock again, compare states. Extract into a helper function or closure to reduce duplication and improve test readability. Test code style follows project conventions; this is a maintenance optimization.
